plugin.battle.copy_setup: Read {0} MB from the start, {1} MB after a seek, {2} round(s).
plugin.battle.err_ts_auth: TorrServer asks for a login: enter the login and password.
plugin.battle.err_ts_reach: TorrServer at {0} does not answer (address, port, or it is stopped).
plugin.battle.intro: The same torrent is read through both servers the way a player reads it, each time from a cold start (the torrent is closed first). The rounds alternate who goes first, so neither gets a warmed-up swarm.
plugin.battle.m_buffer_sub: time until the player has its first 32 MB, s
plugin.battle.m_dlavg_sub: download speed reported by the server, MB/s
plugin.battle.m_peers_sub: most active peers at a time
plugin.battle.m_read_sub: MB per second delivered to the player
plugin.battle.m_seek_sub: jump to the middle of the file, s
plugin.battle.m_seekread_sub: time for the MB after the seek, s
plugin.battle.m_ttfb_sub: from the request to the first data, s
plugin.battle.no_files: Silo has no file list for this torrent yet: open it in Silo once.
plugin.battle.no_range: the server ignored the seek (no HTTP 206)
plugin.battle.no_range_cors: the browser blocked the seek request to TorrServer
plugin.battle.not_cold: Silo did not put the torrent to sleep in time: this run starts warm.
plugin.battle.pick: Choose a torrent and a file.
plugin.battle.read_done: {0}: first byte {1} s, 32 MB in {2} s, {3} MB at {4} MB/s.
plugin.battle.read_hint: Megabytes read from the start over time: the steeper, the better.
plugin.battle.ready: Both servers are ready: file {0} ({1} GiB).
plugin.battle.score_hint: Points: who won each measure (average of the rounds).
plugin.battle.seek: Read after a seek to the middle, MB
plugin.battle.seek_done: {0}: after a seek, first byte {1} s, {2} MB in {3} s.
plugin.battle.silo_wait: Waiting for Silo to put the torrent to sleep (it does that 60 s after the last read)…
plugin.battle.speed_hint: As each server reports it, every second from the start of reading. Solid line: round 1, dashed: the next rounds.
plugin.battle.title: TorrServer vs Silo
plugin.battle.ts_adding: TorrServer does not have this torrent: adding it.
plugin.battle.ts_no_file: TorrServer has no file of the same size.
plugin.battle.ts_no_meta: TorrServer could not get the file list of this torrent in 60 s.
plugin.battle.where_hint: Run it from a computer on a cable if you can: on Wi-Fi or a tablet the network to this device can be slower than the torrent and both servers look the same. Close other playback on the NAS and do not open the torrent's card in Silo or TorrServer while the test runs (an open card keeps the torrent awake).
